name: GALLICUM ACIDUM
key_symptoms: Pain in back of head and neck. Thick, stringy discharge from nose; photophobia with burning of lids.
Pain in lungs; pulmonary hæmorrhage; excessive expectoration. Much mucus in throat in the morning. Dry at night.
guiding_symptoms: Pain in back of head and neck. Thick, stringy discharge from nose; photophobia with burning of lids.
Pain in lungs; pulmonary hæmorrhage; excessive expectoration. Much mucus in throat in the morning. Dry at night.
mind_symptoms: Wild delirium at night; very restless, jumps out of bed; sweats; is afraid to be alone; is rude and abuses every one.
head_symptoms: Pain in back of head and neck. Thick, stringy discharge from nose; photophobia with burning of lids.
respiratory_symptoms: Pain in lungs; pulmonary hæmorrhage; excessive expectoration. Much mucus in throat in the morning. Dry at night.
gi_symptoms: Copious stool; anus feels constricted. Faint feeling after stool. Chronic mucous discharges.
urinary_symptoms: Kidneys painful, distress along ureters into bladder. Dull heavy pain in bladder, directly over pubis. Urine loaded with thick, cream-colored mucus.

source.title: GALLICUM ACIDUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
